connect.title: Connect YouTube to copy videos
connect.description: Sign in with Google to load your playlists and save selected videos to YouTube.

copy.savedUnavailable: YouTube does not expose saved Library playlists through its API. Use a playlist URL or search instead.

sourceInput.playlist: Paste a playlist URL or ID
sourceInput.paste: Paste one or more video URLs

copy.noVideos: Choose or load a source to see videos.
copy.destinationEmpty: Choose a destination playlist to begin.
copy.dropZone: Drag videos here or use Add selected

discard.title: Discard pending copies?
discard.description: Your destination playlist has not changed yet, but this draft will be lost.

duplicates.title: {{count}} duplicate found
duplicates.description: Choose whether videos already present in the destination should be copied again.

success.title: Videos copied
success.description: {{count}} videos were added to your destination playlist.

connect.title: Connect YouTube to move videos
connect.description: Sign in with Google to move videos safely between playlists you own.

warning.title: Moving removes the originals.
warning.description: Each video is removed from the source only after it is added successfully to the destination.

move.dropZone: Drag videos here or use Add selected

discard.title: Discard pending moves?
discard.description: Neither playlist has changed yet, but this move draft will be lost.

duplicates.title: {{count}} duplicate found
duplicates.description: Skipped duplicates remain in the source. Choose whether to add and remove them anyway.

success.title: Videos moved
success.description: {{count}} videos were added to the destination and removed from the source.

connect.title: Connect YouTube to build a playlist
connect.description: Sign in with Google to gather videos and create the finished playlist on YouTube.

draft.title: Playlist draft
draft.empty: Add videos from any source to build your playlist.

confirm.title: Create this playlist?
confirm.description: Create “{{playlist}}” with {{count}} videos? YouTube charges quota for the playlist and every added video.

discard.title: Discard this playlist draft?
discard.description: The gathered videos will be removed from this draft. YouTube has not changed yet.

progress.creatingDescription: Creating the playlist on YouTube before adding videos.

success.title: Playlist created
success.description: Your playlist was created with {{count}} videos.

connect.title: Connect YouTube to merge playlists
connect.description: Sign in with Google to combine owned playlists into one ordered result.

sources.title: Source playlists
sources.description: Add at least two playlists and arrange their merge order.

preview.title: Combined preview
preview.description: Videos follow the source playlist order shown above.
preview.empty: Select playlists to preview the merged result.

merge.sourceError: Retry failed source playlists before merging.
merge.keepsSources: Merging never changes the source playlists. Videos are appended to the destination in preview order.

confirm.title: Merge these playlists?
confirm.description: Add {{count}} videos to “{{playlist}}”? YouTube charges quota for every added video.

progress.creatingDescription: Creating the destination playlist before adding videos.

success.title: Playlists merged
success.description: {{count}} videos were added to the merged playlist.

connect.title: Connect YouTube to duplicate a playlist
connect.description: Sign in with Google to create a faithful copy of one of your playlists.

duplicate.chooseSource: Choose a source playlist to preview its contents.
duplicate.keepsSource: Every available playlist entry is copied in its original order, including intentional repeats.

preview.title: Playlist preview
preview.description: Unavailable videos are shown but will not be copied.
preview.empty: Choose a source playlist to see its videos.

confirm.title: Duplicate this playlist?
confirm.description: Create “{{playlist}}” and copy {{count}} videos? YouTube charges quota for the playlist and every added video.

progress.creatingDescription: Creating the new playlist before copying its videos.

success.title: Playlist duplicated
success.description: The new playlist was created with {{count}} videos.
success.excluded: {{count}} unavailable videos could not be copied.

connect.title: Connect YouTube to reorder a playlist
connect.description: Sign in with Google to preview a new order and save only the necessary moves.

reorder.choose: Choose a playlist to begin reordering.
reorder.empty: This playlist has no videos to reorder.
reorder.instructions: Drag rows or use the arrow controls
reorder.quotaEstimate: Only the minimum required YouTube updates will be sent.

discard.title: Discard the new order?
discard.description: The playlist has not changed on YouTube yet. Your local arrangement will be lost.

success.title: Playlist reordered
success.description: The new order was saved using {{count}} position changes.

connect.title: Connect YouTube to rename and number videos
connect.description: Sign in with Google to preview structured labels and apply titles only to videos you own.

rename.choose: Choose a playlist to preview numbered labels.
rename.empty: This playlist has no videos to label.

warning.title: PlayPick labels only, except videos you own.
warning.description: YouTube titles can be updated only for videos on your channel. Other videos stay as a local preview.

preview.title: Preview · {{count}} labels
preview.description: Owned videos can be saved to YouTube. Everything else is a PlayPick label.

discard.title: Discard these labels?
discard.description: YouTube titles have not changed yet. This numbering preview will be lost.

success.title: Owned titles updated
success.description: {{count}} video titles were updated on YouTube.

connect.title: Connect YouTube to compare playlists
connect.description: Sign in with Google to load two playlists and see what they share or miss.

compare.videoCountHint: Choose a playlist to load its videos.
compare.chooseBoth: Choose two playlists to compare their videos.

confirm.title: Copy these videos?
confirm.description: Add {{count}} videos to {{playlist}}. Videos already there will stay as they are.

connect.title: Connect YouTube to clean playlists
connect.description: Sign in with Google to scan a playlist for duplicate, deleted, and unavailable videos.

cleaner.choose: Choose a playlist to scan for cleanup.

scan.title: Scanning playlist…
scan.description: Checking duplicates, deleted videos, and availability.

clean.title: This playlist looks clean
clean.description: No duplicate, deleted, or unavailable videos were found.

duplicates.title: Duplicate instances
duplicates.empty: No duplicate videos in this playlist.

issues.title: Unavailable entries
issues.description: Deleted, private, and other videos YouTube can no longer play.
issues.empty: No unavailable videos in this playlist.

cleaner.pendingHint: Only extra copies and selected unavailable entries will be removed.

confirm.title: Remove these items?
confirm.description: Remove {{count}} items from {{playlist}}. PlayPick cannot restore them.

success.title: Playlist cleaned
success.description: {{count}} items were removed from the playlist.

connect.title: Connect YouTube to see library insights
connect.description: Sign in with Google to scan your playlists and understand how your library is built.

scan.title: Scanning your library…
scan.description: Loading playlists, video entries, and durations.

insights.partialFailure: {{count}} playlists could not be scanned. Totals may be incomplete.

empty.title: No playlists yet
empty.description: Create or copy a playlist, then scan again to see insights.

years.title: Videos added by year
years.empty: No add dates were available for this library.
